evidence.excerpt: TechCrunch, SiliconANGLE and Just-Auto, 19 Aug 2026: Also, the Rivian micromobility spin-out, raised a $150 million Series D led by Prysm Capital with existing backers Eclipse, Greenoaks and MVP Ventures. The round values Also above $1 billion and takes total funding to $455 million since it was founded less than two years ago. The capital accelerates development of the company's autonomous driving technology and the simultaneous progression of multiple autonomous form factors for moving goods and passengers across urban environments. Taxonomy C1 (consumer mobility hardware).

Also was spun out of Rivian in March 2025 with $105 million led by Eclipse, co-founded by Rivian founder and chief executive RJ Scaringe, who remains chairman, and Chris Yu, who serves as president. Yu was previously Rivian's vice president of future programs and, before that, chief technology officer at Specialized Bicycle Components. The company is headquartered in Palo Alto and opened a Seattle office and retail hub (GeekWire, 2026). No chief marketing officer is named in any listing found.

Bloomberg, 31 Mar 2026: Also raised $200 million at a $1 billion valuation with DoorDash as a strategic investor and commercial partner. This is the round the desk already recorded as N° 214; the August Series D is a separate, later trigger.

Also product materials and reviews (Engadget, New Atlas, CyclingElectric, TechCrunch Oct 2025): the TM-B is a $4,500 modular e-bike with a software-defined, series-hybrid drive unit — pedalling feeds a generator rather than driving the wheel mechanically. Removable smart batteries of 538 Wh and 808 Wh double as USB-C power banks when off the bike; a five-inch Portal touchscreen handles navigation; regenerative braking and up to ten times assist. The TM-Q is the commercial electric delivery quad built on the same platform.

CyclingFlash and TopGear, May 2026: Specialized became the official bicycle and e-bike partner of the Audi Revolut F1 Team, supplying Tarmac road race bikes and the Vado 3 urban electric bike with an 840 Wh battery for team track rides across the 2026 and 2027 seasons. Separately, Electrek and Pinkbike (May 2026): Porsche discontinued Porsche eBike Performance GmbH, the business built from the Greyp and Fazua acquisitions, citing changed market conditions for e-bike drive systems.

Sponsor and team tables plus the Jaguar Racing partners page: Jaguar TCS Racing — TCS title, Castrol, Wolfspeed, OpenText, Dow, Schaeffler (official supplier, e-mobility), Chase (Official Financial Services Partner), Reflo; no bicycle, e-bike or mobility partner. Porsche Formula E Team — Porsche parent, TDK technology partner. Lola Yamaha ABT — Yamaha, a two-wheeler manufacturer, plus Shell. Envision Racing — Envision Group parent, Paysafe title from Season 13. Andretti Formula E — TWG AI, Quest Global, Crowe UK, Reflo. Nissan Formula E Team — Nissan parent. DS Penske, Citroën Racing and Opel GSE — Stellantis entries; TotalEnergies holds energy at DS Penske. Mahindra Racing — Mahindra & Mahindra, Tech Mahindra. Cupra Kiro — Cupra, Kiro. No bicycle, e-bike or micromobility brand appears anywhere on the Formula E grid.

Season 13 (2026/27) calendar table: Jeddah E-Prix double-header 18-19 December 2026 opens the season; Berlin 8-9 May 2027; Monaco 15-16 May 2027; London 29-30 May 2027; Madrid 26-27 June 2027; Tokyo finale 24-25 July 2027.

Formula E (fiaformulae.com): Season 12 achieved PAS 2060-certified carbon neutrality, the first sport globally to do so, and the championship races on street circuits in city centres. The GEN4 car arriving for Season 13 has a peak output of 600 kW (815 bhp), an architecture with no series-hybrid element and a battery two orders of magnitude larger than a micromobility pack.

Nothing of that kind sits anywhere on the Formula E grid, and the championship races where Also sells.

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: On 19 August 2026 Also closed a $150M Series D led by Prysm Capital, with Eclipse, Greenoaks and MVP Ventures returning, at a valuation above $1B. That takes the company to $455M raised since Rivian spun it out in March 2025 with $105M. The money funds autonomous development across multiple form factors for moving goods and passengers through urban environments.

why_now.label: A second capital event in five months
why_now.text: This follows the $200M round at a $1B valuation in March 2026 with DoorDash as strategic investor, which the desk recorded as N° 214 and pointed at Formula 1. Two rounds inside five months, and a shift from a single consumer product to an autonomy platform, is a company deciding what it wants to be known for.

why_now.label: The category just got a price
why_now.text: Specialized became the official bicycle and e-bike partner of the Audi Revolut F1 Team in May 2026, supplying Tarmac road bikes and the Vado 3 urban e-bike for team track rides across two seasons. In the same month Porsche discontinued its eBike Performance business. One buyer entered motorsport; one incumbent left the category. The window is now.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: Season 13 opens with the Jeddah E-Prix on 18-19 December 2026. The European rounds follow in the spring: Berlin 8-9 May, Monaco 15-16 May, London 29-30 May and Madrid 26-27 June 2027. Teams close their partner rosters before a season starts, so a deal agreed this autumn activates from round one.

why_team.label: An open lane on an engineering roster
why_team.text: Jaguar TCS Racing carries TCS as title partner with Castrol, Wolfspeed, OpenText, Dow, Schaeffler, Chase and Reflo. Every one of those is a component, software, energy or services brand. No bicycle, e-bike or mobility partner appears on the team, and none appears anywhere else on the Formula E grid either.

why_team.label: The right brand company
why_team.text: Jaguar is a premium marque rebuilding itself around electric design. A design-led small EV sits naturally beside it in a way it would not beside a volume manufacturer, and both are selling the same idea: that electrification is a design choice rather than a compromise.

why_team.label: The cities
why_team.text: Formula E races on street circuits in city centres. Its Season 13 calendar runs through Berlin, Monaco, London, Madrid, Miami, Tokyo and Shanghai, which is the map a small-EV company sells into. The London E-Prix on 29-30 May 2027 is Jaguar's home round and the natural announcement stage.

why_team.label: Clean of conflicts
why_team.text: The teams that are ruled out are named below with the reason for each. The two that matter: Porsche has just exited the e-bike category, and Lola Yamaha ABT carries a two-wheeler manufacturer.

value.label: Operational, in the paddock (Mode A)
value.text: Street circuits are long, narrow and closed to vehicles, and crews move constantly between garage, pit lane and hospitality. A TM-B fleet covers that movement and the drivers' track rides. The 808 Wh removable battery doubles as a USB-C power bank, which is a real trackside utility rather than a talking point. The TM-Q quad handles paddock logistics.

value.label: On-message for the championship
value.text: Formula E holds PAS 2060-certified carbon neutrality and pushes operational sustainability, not just the racing. Replacing paddock combustion with small EVs is measurable and on-brand for the series as well as the team.

value.label: Audience and content
value.text: Drivers on the bikes on camera at city races is the content unit the category buys, and Formula E's audience is the youngest and most urban in motorsport. That is the same buyer Also sells a design-led e-bike to.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Mobility Partner designation, sidepod placement, team and crew kit presence, hospitality at London and Berlin, and driver access for Also's channels.

note:
# Also → Jaguar TCS Racing — verification log (N° 251, 13 Sep 2026)

Today's signal, built on the operator's ask ("Run today's signal. Compare the ALSO spin out for FE and tell if the use case study or tech integration for that is useful"). The 06:00 automatic run produced no signal: two candidates, River Mobility at 52 and Cognition failing the score gate. Built in-session with `python -m intel.session_case` at no model-API cost.

**Sandbox limitation, stated plainly:** techcrunch.com, bloomberg.com, ridealso.com, jaguar.com and fiaformulae.com are egress-blocked by the proxy. Each claim was checked against the search summary of the primary page named as the evidence URL, corroborated by at least one secondary outlet. Treat every VERIFIED line as REPORTED until a person opens the link. Confidence MEDIUM.

## The question the operator asked: is the tech integration useful?

**Not on the car, and the brief says so in the first risk.** Also's TM-B uses a software-defined, series-hybrid drive in which pedalling feeds a generator rather than turning the wheel; its packs are 538 Wh and 808 Wh; its regen is a consumer feature. A GEN4 Formula E car is direct-drive, peaks at 600 kW and carries a pack two orders of magnitude larger. No engineering transfers. Any brief claiming a car-side technical integration would be inventing one, which is why OPS FIT is scored 13 and not higher.

**Yes in the paddock, and there is a live precedent.** Specialized became Audi's official bicycle and e-bike partner in F1 in May 2026 supplying bikes for team track rides — the same shape of deal, bought by a team this year. Formula E's street circuits make crew movement a genuine operational problem, the removable 808 Wh pack is a real trackside power source, and the TM-Q quad is paddock logistics. The championship's PAS 2060 carbon-neutral certification makes small EVs on-message rather than decorative.

**FE beats F1 for this company on brand, which is the change from N° 214.** The desk's May case put Also at Visa Cash App Racing Bulls in F1 at 70. Formula E races on street circuits in the cities Also sells into and has no bicycle, e-bike or micromobility brand anywhere on the grid, whereas in F1 the category is already claimed by Specialized at Audi. Same company, later trigger, better series: 73.

## Decision path

Chris Yu, Co-Founder & President (micromobility.io interview; TechCrunch; Crunchbase). Path: RJ Scaringe, co-founder and chairman, also Rivian's CEO. No chief marketing officer is named in any listing found. `leadership_ties`: none found — Yu's Specialized tenure is a category precedent, not a sponsorship-deal tie, and the brief treats it as such.

## Things not claimed

- **No revenue figure**: none is public.
- **No European headcount or office claim**: coverage mentioning a Ghent commercial team could not be corroborated in a second source, so it is left out entirely.
- **Deal size ($1.5-3M a year) is an ESTIMATE**, labelled as such.
- The Stellantis and Mahindra rule-outs are stated as group-identity judgments, not as documented category locks.
